Container.Name: joal
Container.Overview:
JOAL is an open-source ratio master with a web UI. It is not designed to help or encourage downloading illegal content: you must respect the law of your country.
First launch: set your own path prefix and secret token, open http://IP:PORT/PATH_PREFIX/ui/ and enter the same host, port, path prefix and secret token in the UI settings. The path prefix is secret, so the template has no WebUI link: add it in the WebUI field (advanced view) if you want one.
Add .torrent files from the UI or drop them in the torrents folder of the Config path.
Container.Requires: Internet access at startup: the image downloads tzdata from the Alpine mirrors on every start and stops if the download fails.

Config.Name: Secret token
Config.Description: WebUI password, choose a long random string

Config.Name: JOAL_PORT
Config.Description: Internal listen port (must match WebUI Port container port)

Config.Name: AUTOUPGRADE
Config.Description: Update OS packages at startup (0 or 1)
